falsifier: Stop DAA before any parameter or risk study if this exact no-control reference is insolvent or incomplete; has nonpositive annualized return, net Sharpe, or doubled-cost Sharpe; has fewer than four profitable chronological folds; has nonpositive bull, bear, or chop return; fails the long-bull or short-bear sleeve role; or fails positive pooled and four-of-six-fold absorption-uplift and composite-rank-IC signs. Controls cannot rescue a failed core.
thesis: A fixed cross-sectional blend of each contract's signed path efficiency and the gap between closing location and aggressive taker-buy share identifies durable relative leaders and laggards across bull, bear, and chop without residualization, funding, a state switch, inverse-volatility sizing, or a directional sleeve tilt.
